newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil lowers large forex band to 1.05-1.14 reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil lowers large forex band to 1.05-1.14 reais.

text.p: Brazil lowered the reais' currency foreign exchange band to between 1.05-1.14 reais against the dollar from a previous range of 0.97-1.06 reais, a Central Bank spokesman said.
The spokesman said the new band had the same 0.09 decimal point spread as the previous band which was announced on Jan 30 1996.

The spokesman offered no further details but said that Central Bank International Foreign Affairs Director Gustavo Franco would be holding a news conference to explain the change later on Tuesday. The large band change had been widely anticipated by the market.
The Central Bank launched the band system to manage exchange rate policy in March 1995, after the Mexican peso crisis.
